es: Leer una propuesta con ojo crítico: detectar puntos débiles, riesgos y preguntas previsibles, y justificarlos.

prompt.es: Escribe el calendario del festival: tres hitos con fechas y un presupuesto breve.

answer.text: Our timeline for the Moon Festival is clear. By 31 March we will have signed the contract with the venue, and this is our first milestone. No later than 15 April we will have paid the insurance fee. Within a month of that date we will be advertising the festival in schools and shops, and the posters will be on every street by the end of May. If we stay on schedule, we will have been preparing for six months when the gates open on 12 September. The budget is 6,000 dollars. We will allocate 3,000 dollars to the music, 500 to the insurance and 800 to advertising. The remaining 1,700 dollars will be our contingency, because we want to stay calm even if something goes wrong. In this way, every volunteer will know what to do, and the council will see that our plan is serious, realistic and ready to start.
accepted: Our timeline for the Moon Festival is clear. By 31 March we will have signed the contract with the venue, and this is our first milestone. No later than 15 April we will have paid the insurance fee. Within a month of that date we will be advertising the festival in schools and shops, and the posters will be on every street by the end of May. If we stay on schedule, we will have been preparing for six months when the gates open on 12 September. The budget is 6,000 dollars. We will allocate 3,000 dollars to the music, 500 to the insurance and 800 to advertising. The remaining 1,700 dollars will be our contingency, because we want to stay calm even if something goes wrong. In this way, every volunteer will know what to do, and the council will see that our plan is serious, realistic and ready to start.

First, the venue: we will have signed the contract by 31 March, which is our first milestone. Second, the insurance: no later than 15 April we will have paid the fee. Third, the promotion: within three weeks we will be advertising in every school and shop. By the time the festival opens, we will have been working on it for half a year. Our budget is 6,000 dollars in total. We will allocate 3,000 dollars to the music, 500 dollars to the insurance and 800 dollars to advertising, and we will keep 1,700 dollars as a contingency fund. With this schedule and this budget, the council can be sure that the festival is feasible and that nobody will pay more than planned.

We recommend that the council approve the square for one afternoon, and we request a grant of 500 dollars for tables and posters.
